text:
Write the work plan for Willow (modules: indexer, feed, session, notify, ingest, webhooks). Withdrawn drafts (notify timeout_s 15, webhooks ttl_s 330) are void.

Fixed values: notify retry_limit exactly 4, timeout_s 90; webhooks ttl_s 510; ingest ttl_s 390 (client requirement) and batch_size at least 800; feed max_workers at most 6.

Hard constraints: feed must not depend on indexer, even indirectly; session and ingest run on worker alpha; session and webhooks never share a worker; feed and webhooks share a worker; session depends on notify; ingest depends on session; feed rolls out before session; bench.py and client.py belong to session.

Process: code review turnaround under one day; security review at month end.

Optional: session retry_limit around 5. Not required: notify on beta, linter choice, shared metrics library, naming, separate databases. Everything else is the team's call.
